explanation: On this hybrid-GPU Windows 11 laptop (Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX iGPU + discrete NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 Laptop GPU), all desktop/OS display compositing runs on the Intel iGPU, so the discrete RTX 5080 sits at 0 MiB used when idle. When llama-server loads a GGUF checkpoint with fixed flags (--ctx-size 8192 --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0), it is the sole CUDA compute process on the RTX 5080 and deterministically allocates the exact same MiB buffer on every load.
